title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 18-Inch Solid Brass Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 18-Inch Solid Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom towel storage with a wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass in the coordinated Carolina Collection. The straight-bar design helps keep towels within easy reach while saving space with a clean wall-mounted install.

Highlights:
- Solid brass construction for enduring everyday use
- Wall mount design helps save floor space in the bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean finished look
- Installation hardware included for straightforward setup
- Coordinates with matching pieces from the Carolina Collection

Specs:
- Category: Towel Bars
- Style: Traditional
- Shape: Straight bar
- Center-to-center: 18-Inch
- Bar diameter: 0.75-Inch
- Overall length: 20-Inch
- Projection: 2-Inch
- Height: 3.5-Inch; Width: 2-Inch
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Includes: towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish options: available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes
